actual_family.data: unique canonical word, retained nonzero loads, external t-avoidance, Q^[1], and U_11
actual_family.capacity_admission: a nonzero p-independent q-free residual H with U_11|H and log|H|=o(log b) would prove zero rate

residual_class.prime_independence: integer numerator and denominator do not depend on the candidate prime
residual_class.denominator: V_n is a unit on every assigned externally t-saturated singleton chart
residual_class.forcing: generic polynomial identity on localized singleton charts, not accidental equality only at the actual point

proved.degree_support: a noncontent numerator assigned all N charts has load degree at least N and involves every active load
proved.bounded_window: a numerator omitting an assigned row must be the zero polynomial modulo p
proved.portfolio: a noncontent member assigned S_l has degree at least |S_l|; an all-noncontent full cover has total degree at least N
proved.content_capture: a low-degree or omitted-row numerator forced generically modulo p has p dividing every coefficient
proved.actual_content_implication: if every actual U_11 prime enters a content branch, U_11 divides the product of the corresponding nonzero coefficient contents
proved.unit_denominator: a p-unit rational denominator cannot evade numerator saturation

inadmissible.candidate_dependent_constant: inserts p or reassembles U_11 by CRT
inadmissible.vanishing_denominator: undefined quotient, not a numerator zero

closes: primitive nonzero generic residuals of load degree below N

all-noncontent bounded portfolios with total degree below covered rows
p-unit rational denominators as an escape
does_not_close: nonzero sub-beta coefficient content with actual divisibility
the actual singleton mass or Route 1
